_comment: English edition (Ireland) learning resources. Hand-checked on 2026-11-15. This is a list of standing official resources, not a calendar of events.

meta.title: Learning resources for hospital AI governance in Ireland
meta.description: Official guidance and strategy documents that hospital administrators and compliance teams use to learn about AI governance, data and device safety in Ireland.
meta.lead: There is no single official events calendar for hospital AI in Ireland. Here are standing resources from official sources, each opened and read.

notice: Standing resources, not scheduled events. Check each page for what it currently offers.

items.name: HIQA national guidance on AI in health and social care
items.body: Start with the press release, which explains the structure around four principles and who the guidance is for.

items.name: HIQA draft guidance (January 2026)
items.body: A fuller read of examples for services, staff and people using services, labelled as a draft.

items.name: AI for Care strategy 2026-2030
items.body: Principles, pillars and the roadmap that frame AI adoption in Irish health services.

items.name: Data Protection Commission on AI and LLMs
items.body: A short guide to the data protection questions to ask before using an AI product.

items.name: HPRA guidance for hospitals on devices
items.body: How devices are regulated and what hospitals should understand, including in-house manufacturing.

items.name: HPRA: managing field safety corrective actions
items.body: A six-step process for acting on manufacturer notices, including software updates.

items.name: HPRA: reporting device safety issues
items.body: What counts as a serious incident and how to report it.

items.name: EU AI Act (full text)
items.body: Articles 4, 6, 26, 27 and 50 and Annexes I and III are the parts most relevant to hospitals.

items.name: GDPR (full text)
items.body: Articles 9, 22, 33, 34 and 35 are the parts most relevant to hospital AI.

items.name: HIQA news feed
items.body: Add the feed to a reader to see new HIQA publications; this site also lists them under HIQA news.
